+def descend_waypoints(plan, ctx, target):
+    """Follow the short vertical descent on its local IK branch, with live gates."""
+    arm = ctx.arms[plan.side]
+    frame = ctx.observe(plan.epoch)
+    start = frame.palm(arm, plan.side)
+    shift = target.update(frame)
+    end = plan.palm.copy()
+    end[:3, 3] += shift
+    count = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3, 3] - start[:3, 3]) / 0.01)))
+    checked = live_check(ctx, plan.side, (plan.label,))
+    for fraction in np.linspace(0., 1., count + 1)[1:]:
+        frame = ctx.observe(plan.epoch)
+        shift = target.update(frame)
+        goal = plan.palm.copy()
+        goal[:3, 3] = (1 - fraction) * start[:3, 3] + fraction * (plan.palm[:3, 3] + shift)
+        measured = frame.arm_joints(plan.side)
+        solved = arm.solve(inverse(frame.world_torso) @ goal, measured, restarts=False)
+        if solved is None or np.max(np.abs(solved - measured)) > 0.5:
+            raise SkillFailure("ARM_NOT_REACHED", "Local descent waypoint did not solve")
+        rows = joint_rows(measured, solved, ctx.settings.physics.arm_rate, ctx.settings.servo.tick)
+        follow_rows(ctx, plan.epoch, plan.side, rows, checked, tracked_target=target)
+    follow_rows(ctx, plan.epoch, plan.side,
